body:
### Summary

When `LenientRequirement` fixes a missing dot before `*` on a three-part version whose middle segment has two digits, it drops the leading digits and rewrites the version to a different release series. For example, `requests==2.32.3*` in `pyproject.toml` is rewritten to `requests==2.3.*` and resolves `requests==2.3.0` without warning by default (whereas single-digit `requests==2.2.0*` is rewritten to `requests==2.2.0.*` and resolves `requests==2.2.0`).

Minimal reproduction:

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/example && cd /tmp/example
cat > pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[project]
name = "example"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["requests==2.32.3*"]
EOF
uv pip compile pyproject.toml
```

Output:

```text
Resolved 1 package in 7ms
# This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:
#    uv pip compile pyproject.toml
requests==2.3.0
    # via example (pyproject.toml)
```

(`uv lock` and `uv sync` on the same `pyproject.toml` also resolve and install `requests==2.3.0`.)

Expected `requests==2.32.3*` to be rewritten to `requests==2.32.3.*` (resolving `requests==2.32.3`) or rejected as an invalid version specifier, rather than silently resolving `requests==2.3.0`.

Verbose output (`uv pip compile pyproject.toml -v`):

```text
DEBUG Found workspace root: /tmp/example
DEBUG Adding root workspace member: /tmp/example
DEBUG Skipping `pyproject.toml` in `/tmp/example` (no `[tool]` section)
...
DEBUG uv 0.13.10 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)
...
WARN Fixing invalid requirement by inserting missing dot (before: `requests==2.32.3*`; after: `requests==2.3.*`)
DEBUG Found static `requires-dist` for: /tmp/example
DEBUG Solving with installed Python version: 3.14.10
DEBUG Solving with target Python version: >=3.14.10
DEBUG Adding direct dependency: requests>=2.3.dev0, <2.4.dev0
DEBUG Found fresh response for: https://pypi.org/simple/requests/
DEBUG Searching for a compatible version of requests (>=2.3.dev0, <2.4.dev0)
DEBUG Found fresh response for: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/f7/51/7aa1e337862118bee783c0249debd64cb07b8fbdfef154b1e185754b02d5/requests-2.3.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl.metadata
DEBUG Selecting: requests==2.3.0 [compatible] (requests-2.3.0-py2.py3-none-any.whl)
DEBUG Tried 1 versions: requests 1
DEBUG marker environment resolution took 0.001s
Resolved 1 package in 3ms
# This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:
#    uv pip compile pyproject.toml
requests==2.3.0
    # via example (pyproject.toml)
```

In `crates/uv-pypi-types/src/lenient_requirement.rs`, the `"inserting missing dot"` fixup uses `regex!(r"(\d\.\d)+\*").replace_all(input, r"${1}.*")`: because `+` is outside capture group 1, `2.32.3*` matches `(\d\.\d)` twice (`2.3` then `2.3`) and `${1}` retains only the last group (`2.3`).

### Platform

Linux 6.1.0-56-cloud-amd64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.13.10 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) and main (`e3e7c1eacb980339352a5ad69affcd3b6c206c92`)

### Python version

Python 3.14.10

We found this while fuzzing.

Credit: https://ucsbplse.github.io/
title: LenientRequirement missing-dot fixup rewrites requests==2.32.3* to requests==2.3.*
